personality_one_liner: A modern, polished, and highly legible fintech app where the spending data is the hero, framed by crisp whites and premium sage greens.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards never flush to screen edge; always use md or lg margin. Whitespace is intentional to group related data without heavy dividers.

do's: Use glass on bottom tab bar, sticky headers over scrolling lists, and the centered FAB container
Ensure text on glass is fully readable by adding a subtle translucent base tint beneath the blur
dont's: Do not use glass on form inputs or generic list rows
Do not blur entire screens or body content

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: A quick overview of monthly spending total, category breakdown chart, and recent transactions.

states.loading: Centered spinner over the chart area.
states.empty: No spending yet! An illustration of an empty minimalist folder with a prompt to add a transaction.
states.error: Failed to load dashboard data. Retry button centered.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header (Title 'Dashboard' + current month). Hero card: Total Spent amount with a subtle gradient (brandTertiary to surfaceSecondary), rounded lg. Below it, a clean circular Donut chart for category breakdown with an inner label. Followed by a 'Recent Transactions' section header and a single column list of transaction cards. Transactions have a tinted icon container (brandTertiary) and amount on the right.

screens.name: Add Expense (Scanner)
screens.purpose: Capture or upload a payment screenshot (UPI) with an AI-extraction preview and editable fields.

states.loading: Full-screen scanning animation overlay while AI extracts amount and merchant.
states.empty: Camera viewfinder or gallery upload prompt.
states.error: Couldn't read screenshot text. Show an error banner and allow manual entry.

screens.layout: Camera-first layout with a full-bleed viewfinder overlay (edge guides). A persistent bottom sheet contains primary CTAs: 'Upload Photo', 'Scan', 'Enter Manually'. Post-scan, transition to a preview screen: top half shows the cropped screenshot receipt with a top-to-bottom gradient scrim, bottom half shows an editable form (Amount, Merchant Name, Category dropdown picker). Sticky 'Save Expense' CTA pinned to the bottom.

screens.name: Transactions
screens.purpose: Scrollable list of all expenses with quick filters and search.

states.empty: No transactions match the selected filters.
states.error: Error fetching transactions. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Glass sticky header with a Search input field. Below search, a horizontal scrollable row of filter chips (pill shape, surfaceTertiary for inactive, brandPrimary for active). The main content is a single-column list of transaction rows. Implement swipe-to-delete on rows using react-native-gesture-handler.

screens.name: Budgets
screens.purpose: Set monthly budgets per category and track remaining limits visually.

states.empty: Illustration with a CTA 'Set your first budget'.
states.error: Could not load budgets. Retry button.

screens.layout: List of budget cards. Each card displays the Category Icon, Title, and '₹Spent of ₹Total' on top. Below the text, a horizontal progress bar. The bar color adapts based on percentage: brandPrimary (safe), warning (>80%), error (>100%).

upload_background.alt: Blank receipt texture for scanner overlay context

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the iOS-Native Clean layout: ample padding, clear typography hierarchy, and a predominantly light theme with off-white (F2F2F7) background and stark white (FFFFFF) cards.
Do not use any blue, purple, or indigo anywhere. Stick to the brand palette (Moss Green, Charcoal, Off-White).
For the bottom navigation, place Home, Transactions, Budgets, and Insights in the bar, and float the 'Add' action as a prominent FAB layered in the center or above the tab bar.

The scanner screen should simulate a camera view using expo-camera if possible, or fall back to an image upload view. The preview should show the cropped receipt with a gradient scrim (top-to-bottom) ensuring the editable form overlaid beneath it is perfectly readable.
For the Budgets screen, strictly build the progress bars to change color contextually: brandPrimary normally, warning (orange) at 80%, error (red) at 100%.

Transactions must be a flat list of rows containing a leading tinted icon container (brandTertiary square with md radius), the merchant name, and the amount on the trailing edge. Include native swipe-to-delete.
When displaying a generic category icon, map categories to specific Phosphor icons (e.g., ForkKnife for Food, ShoppingCart for Groceries).
All primary CTAs (e.g., 'Save Expense') must be sticky at the bottom of the screen with proper Safe Area clearances and glassmorphism behind them to allow content to scroll underneath.
